launches.tagline: An AI interviewer that's trained to evaluate AI-first skills across roles with integrity built-in
launches.body:
I’m Vivek, Co-founder and CEO at HackerRank (YC S11). We’re launching a new product - Chakra: an AI Interviewer that actually helps hiring teams screen candidates faster with evidence-backed interview reports.

**The problem we see**

We’re seeing recruiters and hiring managers are dealing with:

* Too many applicants and too much scheduling overhead for early rounds.
* Lower signal-to-noise because many applications are polished by AI or outright fabricated .
* Rising interview integrity issues — including tools marketed to “cheat” during interviews.

Teams spend tons of valuable human time on the wrong candidates - and hiring managers don’t trust early-round signals.

**What Is Chakra**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97749&key=user_uploads/10668/d2057e04-0171-4320-9e63-77ae90329042)

\
\
Chakra is an AI Interviewer by HackerRank that runs structured, voice/video screening interviews based on your rubric and delivers decision-ready reports backed by evidence.

Demo video - <https://youtu.be/6v5h-7Q4O2c>  

**How it works**

1. Configure the role, competencies, and rubric in a chat-based setup.
2. Invite candidates easily via email, a simple link, or directly through your ATS
3. Chakra conducts a voice/video based interview on your behalf, intelligently adapting to get the signals you need.
4. You get an instant report with an actionable recommendation, skill-level feedback aligned with your rubric, transcript references, and full session replay.

**What makes it different**

There are a lot of “AI interviewers” right now, but most fall into one of two buckets:

1. Niche / single-skill evaluators, or
2. Single-modal experiences that don’t generate robust, trustworthy signal

Chakra is designed to be multi-modal (voice, video, IDE, whiteboard etc.) and versatile across roles, while still producing grounded, auditable evidence in the report.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97749&key=user_uploads/10668/43e35ddd-bdde-4c00-b579-324bdc45b650)

**YC community asks / offers**

* If you’re hiring right now, you can try [this sample FDE interview](https://www.chakra.sh/interviewer/1enskc0p2qs/session), I’d love feedback on:
  * Rubric setup (does it match how you actually hire?)
  * Candidate experience (does it feel fair and natural?)
  * Report quality (is it truly decision-ready?)
* You can request access at [chakra.sh](http://chakra.sh)
* Or simply reach me at @rvivek on X or via email at [vivek@hackerrank.com](mailto:vivek@hackerrank.com)

launches.body:
Hey YC!

tl;dr Using a work sample, we **automatically measure** whether someone’s likely to succeed in an entry-level support role.

### Why?

In our last company, Paul & I manually read \~25,000 job applications, specifically for entry-level ops and sales roles. (For example: customer support, real estate ISAs, “pre-sales” support, data, entry, taxi dispatchers, receptionists)

We learned a lot, but eventually Paul said he felt “default dead inside” after reading 300 resumes in a row. So we decided to build tools to scale ourselves up.

### The problem

1. Reading resumes is _time-consuming_. Also, for entry-level jobs, resumes don’t tell you very much.
2. Wasting time interviewing candidates who clearly can’t do the job (i.e. the ops equivalent of fizz buzz)
3. Hiring candidates who **interview well**, but don’t do the **actual work** very well

### Our solution

We built a 30-minute **interactive work sample** that you can give to all of your job applicants.

If you’re like our early users, “ops hiring” is currently being run by a very high-leverage leader. That’s awesome — because you’ll have a high bar — but it’s also extremely expensive.

**With Loop, you can raise that bar even higher, while saving 20+ hours of work** (reading resumes, reading applications, conducting interviews) **per hire.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64776&key=user_uploads/122083/ea0fe803-d00c-447f-9cf6-66b58c6a491c)

We recommend benchmarking Loop with your top employees. Then, you can use our platform to identify job applicants with similar skills 🙂

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64776&key=user_uploads/122083/4a8ab797-5de5-4d1b-8b2d-915eb18750b0)

In building this for our own company, we learned a couple unexpected things:

1. **Great candidates don’t necessarily have relevant experience.** Top performers come from an incredibly wide range of backgrounds. Our very best agent used to edit a niche industry newsletter.
2. We increased our interview-to-hire rate from 18% to 48%. As a direct result, we became happier people, less cynical and Malthusian. It’s a joke, but it’s also real.

### OK, I’m interested in being a happier person

Great! [Sign up here](https://www.loopsupport.com) and use the code LAUNCHYC for a 49% discount off your first month.

Curious how you’d do on the assessment yourself? [Give it a spin here](https://challenge.loopsupport.com/try), and we’ll let you know how you compare to the average applicant :)

# tl;dr:

• Today, Dover is launching Recruiting Partners, connecting you with seasoned recruiters who work as an extension of your team.

# Dover Recruiting Partners

We're thrilled to launch Dover Recruiting Partners – our biggest update yet to how startups can hit their hiring goals and hire the best talent.

Over the past 5 years, Dover has helped 1500+ companies like Stripe, Scale AI, OpenSea, Benchling, and Vanta attract and hire top talent. Now, we’re introducing our most flexible and full-service hiring solution for startups: Dover Recruiting Partners.

# 🚀 What are Dover Recruiting Partners?

Dover Recruiting Partners are vetted fractional recruiters who can work as an extension of your team. We only accept the top 2% of recruiters.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84634&key=user_uploads/5516/5b78d9d2-2b56-4bf3-8c70-9d233f4a3396)

# Key features

1️⃣ On-demand expertise: Get help from experienced recruiters when you need it, without the overhead of a full-time hire. Perfect for startups and companies with variable hiring needs.

2️⃣ Flexible pricing: Ramp up or down based on your hiring needs – pay only for the hours you use.

3️⃣ Tech-enabled efficiency: Recruiters can use Dover’s ATS, Sourcing Extension, and other tools so they can focus on strategic work and keep their costs low.

4️⃣ Transparent metrics: We share cost-per-hire and fill rates for our recruiters before you hire them so you can find the perfect recruiter for you.

# 🤔 Why did we build this?

Recruiting consistently ranks as a top 3 problem for startups, regardless of their stage or industry. Before companies are big enough to justify hiring a full-time recruiter, they often have to resort to agencies.

We like to say with agencies, "You'll be unhappy either way"—either you won't make a hire and waste time, or you will make a hire and pay $30k+ per placement. There’s a reason you don’t hire engineers or marketers on “contingency.”

We wanted to provide a more flexible, higher-quality solution. Dover Recruiting Partners gives you access to top-tier recruiting talent without the long-term commitment or exorbitant fees. Our fractional recruiting model allows you to work with a separate expert recruiter for each role you're hiring for, whether it's a senior engineer, a sales leader, or a product manager.

# 💰 How much does it cost?

Most companies spend an average of $80 per hour, depending on the services they use. The cost per hire across the platform varies, but it usually ends up being between $4 and $7k.

# 🚀 How do I get started?

Head to [dover.com/recruiter](http://dover.com/recruiter) and click "Get matched with a recruiter". We'll set you up with a free call to understand your needs and match you with the perfect Recruiting Partner.

We're excited to help companies of all sizes build amazing teams. If you have any questions, drop them in the comments or email me directly at [max@dover.com](mailto:max@dover.com).

Read more about how we got here on our blog: <https://www.dover.com/blog/introducing-dover-recruiting-partners>

Happy hiring! 🎉

launches.body:
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XDETxEtJiCQ&t=1s>

Applicant volume for roles in tech has risen 2.4x in 2023 from last year’s averages. Yet it’s harder to filter down to top candidates and you can’t get back to everyone. It sucks for candidates too — they never hear back, and candidate experience takes a hit.

The proprietary tech that powers our automated outbound sourcing engine is now applied to reveal top applicants across all your job boards. Use extremely powerful filters and chat to find candidates matching exactly what you’re looking for and review resumes 10x faster — for free.

**What is Dover?**

Over the last five years, Dover (YC S19) has enabled Scale AI, OpenSea, Benchling, Vanta, Stripe, and 500+ other startups to make thousands of hires. You may have seen some of our other launches like our [Applicant Tracking System](https://www.producthunt.com/products/dover#free-ats-by-dover) and [Sourcing Autopilot](https://www.producthunt.com/posts/dover-autopilot).

**What’s different from other resume review tools?**

Dover’s AI Applicant Sorting goes far beyond keywords. Dover has a knowledge graph of companies, industries, skillsets, and more.

AI Applicant Sorting allows you to use super powerful filters and chat to find candidates based on exactly what you’re looking for.

As you review candidates, quickly approve or reject with a click. Take bulk actions to send the next steps in a fraction of the time. Use hotkeys to speed up review time even more.

**What kinds of queries can I sort or filter by?**

It’s AI-powered, so you can get pretty nuanced:

* “6+ years experience”
* “based in the US or Canada”
* “candidates with a fintech background”
* "people with experience at B2C startups”
* “people who have worked on scalable systems”
* “full stack engineers or people with similar titles”
* “applicants who worked at well-reputed companies”
* "account executives with experience at SaaS startups"
* “product managers working in healthcare in San Francisco"
* “candidates with FAANG experience who went to a top school”
* "software engineers with at least 5 years of experience with React or Typescript experience"

**How hard is it to set up?**

Import existing applicants from your Applicant Tracking System or get new candidates by posting a job for free with Dover’s ATS, which has everything startups need to build a great recruiting process and candidate experience. It costs $0 and takes 10 minutes to set up.

Just want to try it out? Start using the tool with sample candidates in only a few minutes.

**How much does it cost?**

Dover’s AI Applicant Sorting is totally free to use, just like our Applicant Tracking System.

**Why is Dover releasing this for free?**

Dover’s mission is to help every company run an incredible hiring process and every candidate has a great experience. The best way to do this is by building easy-to-use tools to help every company get the basics right.

We make money by selling [Sourcing Autopilot](http://dover.com/sourcing-autopilot) and [Embedded Recruiter](http://dover.com/embedded-recruiter) to companies that need help with sourcing or full-cycle recruiting.

**How do you ensure the AI doesn’t create bias?**

If you throw AI at a problem, bias can be created. We’ve built this model by inputting specific data and criteria and examining what’s happening with the AI output. We use AI to make it faster and easier.

We built this feature to make sure you find people who should get a second look and to ensure everyone hears back from you. AI is used to sort candidates, Dover doesn’t autoreject based on its output.

**How do I get started?**

Get started [**here**](https://www.dover.com/ai-sorting?utm_source=bookface&utm_campaign=ai_sorting_bfwww.dover.com/ai-sorting?utm_source=bookface&utm_campaign=ai_sorting_bf).

launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Easily customize GitHub-based technical assessments, where candidates can complete tasks like reviewing code, submitting a pull request, or improving a system’s design. Hatchways helps you build a state-of-the-art practical interview process that is customized to your role while saving you engineering interview load along the way.

# 👋 The Origin Story

I've shared my personal struggle with traditional interviews on [HackerNews](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=20578850) and how I’ve never been great at "performing" on the spot.

This summarizes well what our mission has always been: _“Mainstream hiring processes are biased towards those who went to great schools, had high GPAs, are native-English speaking, have worked at brand name companies, are extroverts and great networkers, etc. But there are so many talented people who don't fit that profile. We're excited to work on ways of hiring that give them a better chance.”_

Over time, we realized the challenge in solving this issue lies in the fact that companies lack incentives to improve their processes unless it saves them money or time.

Thus, Hatchways is on a mission to make talent discovery efficient yet fair. By streamlining skill evaluations, we help companies save time while hiring top talent with the right skills for the job, rather than focusing on pedigree, connections, or interview prowess.

# 🤔**The Problem: Inefficient Interviewing**

Many companies struggle with inefficient interviewing— spending too much time while not getting quality signal.

Although creating a unique process is time-consuming, mimicking FAANG approaches, which most companies do, leads to inaccurate signal, a lot of wasted engineering hours, and increased competition for the same talent pool.

# 💡**The Solution: Design a Purposeful Interview Experience**

Hatchways enables you to develop an effective interview process, ensuring accurate signal capture, time savings for engineers, and a positive candidate experience.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=71240&key=user_uploads/321746/b44f8b5f-fbf0-4990-a37e-67afc3768fc5)

# 🦄 **How it works:**

* **Adopt Best Practices from Leading Tech Companies, and Tailor to your Needs:** We've distilled best practices from tech leaders at Dropbox, Plaid, and Airtable (e.g., crafting rubrics, enhancing candidate experience, setting pass-through rates) and can easily customize them for your company, role, and specific hiring needs.
* **Custom Rubrics and Tailored Interview Questions:** Most companies introduce interviewing rubrics too late. This leads to standardization and bias issues, resulting in inconsistent hiring outcomes. We assist in identifying crucial skills and transforming them into a grading rubric to shape the perfect interview question.
* **Streamline Grading and Optimize Calibration Effortlessly:** With Hatchways, use our automation features to build test cases or utilize our human-assisted reviewers to reduce your engineering review load. Drawing from the best practices of leading technical teams, we establish a starting benchmark and optimize your on-site pass-through rates over time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=71240&key=user_uploads/321746/d2286ba9-dc3f-4647-b835-7b4faf858137)

### **Use Cases**

What companies use Hatchways for:

* pre-screen technical assessment (i.e. resume replacement)
* technical phone-screen step (i.e. 60-90 minute live coding replacement)
* university/intern recruiting (i.e. high-volume vetting)

Who is this for?

* Companies scaling engineering hiring who are aiming to reduce interviewer load
* Companies aiming to introduce greater standardization in their interview process

# **Asks**

* If you’re an engineer who wants to see companies adopt more effective and fair interviewing practices - share this with them
* For companies aiming to streamline their interview process while ensuring a fair and enjoyable candidate experience, sign up on our platform [here](https://www.hatchways.io/?utm_source=ycombinator&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=launch_yc) or reach out directly to me to learn more: [jaclyn@hatchways.io](mailto:jaclyn@hatchways.io)

launches.body:
**tldr; Canada is facing a skilled labour shortage. Airwork is solving this by connecting businesses with the top 5% of general and skilled labourers on a flexible basis. Companies can fill any shift within 2 hours, and workers can work on their own terms. Check us out at **[**airwork.io**](http://airwork.io)**!**

Hey everyone, 👋

I’m [Gary](https://www.linkedin.com/in/garyjlin/), the founder of [Airwork](https://airwork.io). We’re a team of 5 building a marketplace to solve Canada’s labour shortage and give everyone the power to work on their own terms.

### **Problem: Canadian businesses are struggling with staffing**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73045&key=user_uploads/425576/dbbd3422-576c-41db-aab8-2ae66e7c6bb0)

In Q4 of 2022, 36.9% of all Canadian businesses experienced difficulties hiring skilled labourers, led by construction (49.5%), manufacturing (47.4%), and food services (46.3%). We spoke to over 100 companies, and more than half have experienced one of these within the last 90 days:

👎 Candidate doesn’t show up to interview

👎 Candidate signs offer but doesn’t show up on the first day

👎 Employee quit without notice

👎 Employee consistently shows up late or leaves early

👎 Skilled labour positions go unfilled for months due to lack of applicants

### **🎉 Solution: Airwork 🎉**

Airwork is an on-demand labour marketplace that lets managers book vetted workers online within minutes. We spent the last year building in private beta and are now launching in **public beta**! 💪 🚀 📈

Airwork’s vetting process involves a resume screen, attendance test, background check, and video interview. As a result, out of tens of thousands of applicants, only the top 5% are selected.

We’re live the Greater Toronto Area, just expanded to all of Southern Ontario, and plan to expand across Canada.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73045&key=user_uploads/425576/78a4a429-d2f2-4752-82b5-83f74d4e9656)

To date, Airworkers have filled skilled and general roles for:\
1\. Manufacturing plants\
2\. Warehouses and logistics companies\
3\. Construction companies\
4\. Events, conferences, and weddings\
5\. Commercial cleaning and facility services\
6\. Commercial printing

Workers can download Airwork on the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and apply to become an Airworker. Airworkers can book shifts nearby and get paid within the same day.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73045&key=user_uploads/425576/4fe06d68-03a9-44ec-b1d0-2a860ba9d9ff)

Our business portal also enables managers to create shifts, manage rosters, trigger backfills, and track time sheets all in one place. We also automate administrative and compliance complexities, reducing the overhead of workforce management:

✅ WSIB insurance coverage\
✅ RCMP-backed criminal record checks\
✅ Payroll and time-tracking\
✅ Automated backfilling

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73045&key=user_uploads/425576/8890f4bb-d0a4-41e8-9421-eb96fc0fbe05)

### **Do you need workers?**

Are you in Southern Ontario? Sign up for a free account at [airwork.io](http://airwork.io) and try us out! If not, reach out to [gary@airwork.io](mailto:gary@airwork.io) to join your city’s waitlist.

### **Do you know someone that might need workers?**

Send a referral to [gary@airwork.io](mailto:gary@airwork.io). Once your referee books 10 shifts on Airwork, we’ll give you a $1,000 CAD referral bonus! 💸

### **Do you want to take control of your work schedule?**

Download our app on the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/ca/app/airwork/id1644979123) or [Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.airwork.Llama) and get apply to become an Airworker today! 💪

launches.title: 🧋 Taro - Faster Career Growth for Software Engineers

launches.body:
**tl;dr**: Your career growth shouldn’t depend on your ability to find a good mentor or manager. Taro brings together top SWEs with proven insights to scale your career. **Check out our** [**website**](https://bit.ly/taro_app_web) **and** [**YouTube channel**](https://bit.ly/rahul_yt)**.**

Taro helps full-time engineers get onboarded and promoted faster. We do this through Q&A and case studies from tech veterans, organized by company and level.

### **⛔️ The Problem**

As a software engineer, you already know how to code. But **software engineering is so much more than coding**.

Over the last 2 years, Alex and I built a community of 50K software engineers on [YouTube](https://youtube.com/rpandey1234), [Slack,](https://join.slack.com/t/techcareergrowth/shared_invite/zt-1ctxuq8h2-b3nnkQG0MtXyBpvrEFpgqQ) and [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/71614174/admin/). We talked to hundreds of engineers and found that their career bottleneck was not their coding ability, but how effectively they managed projects, understood the context, and communicated blockers.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=65087&key=user_uploads/192956/5ded8a2b-c6e4-4a8f-b6e8-039c9d7335a8)

Left to right:

[📱 Alex](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alexander-chiou/) has mentored dozens of engineers to Senior+ levels across his time at Meta and Robinhood.

[🎓 Rahul](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rpandey1234/) has taught thousands of engineers through his role as a Stanford lecturer, LinkedIn Learning instructor, and YouTube creator.

What separates an average engineer from a great engineer is the ability to independently create business impact, and that doesn’t get taught in a CS degree or a bootcamp. Taro fills the gap.

### **💡 Our Solution**

1. A Q&A database from real engineers, with answers from industry experts. **All questions are tagged by company + level, which makes it easy to find relevant content.** [Here’s a sample](https://app.jointaro.com/question/mvMQj8228kuUe38BvdT9).
2. Case studies from eng leads + managers at top tech companies.
3. A community of software engineers at top companies who share insights + advice.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=65087&key=user_uploads/192956/62f78267-822d-4ab1-a232-5c3f586b48d9)

### **💁🏽‍♀️ Target Audience**

We already have 100+ Taro Premium members from companies like Meta, Google, TikTok, and Amazon (along with thousands of free users).

Taro is a great fit for **full time engineers at fast-moving tech companies**. Taro is **not** a good fit for freelancers or students who are still exploring software engineering.

### **❓Our Ask**

1. Reach out if you’re an engineer starting a new role, or are aiming for a promotion.
2. Tell us what upskilling products you’ve used for engineers!

Shoot us an email at [team@jointaro.com](mailto:team@jointaro.com) — our app is available for web, Android, and iOS at <https://joinTaro.com>.

launches.body:
**📌 TLDR**: When you hire employees, you’ll need Workers’ Compensation Insurance. The price for this insurance depends on your payroll and employee duties. Since your payroll and employee duties change annually, you’ll go through an audit process to determine the proper amount you should be paying. In the backend, this process is costly and inefficient, and you probably end up underpaying/overpaying. We use a combination of LLMs and human judgment, leading to higher-quality audits at half the price of traditional audit solutions.\
—

Hi everyone, we’re [Hussein](https://linkedin.com/in/hussein-syed-44115a164) and [Omar](https://linkedin.com/in/omar-dadabhoy), and we’re creating [Arcimus](https://www.arcimus.com/)! 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77849&key=user_uploads/977376/187811a1-ef85-43ca-9203-7a8e3eab50b5)

### **📑 Problem:**

Workers' compensation insurance pricing depends on a business’s total payroll and its employees' duties (a roofer is at higher risk of injury than a Software Engineer). However, these factors change as companies hire/fire and change salaries.

Every year, insurance companies contract auditing firms or individual premium auditors to hand review their customers’ information. They report changes in total payroll and employee duties, enabling insurance carriers to assign them a new premium.

This manual process can take auditors 1-3 hours per customer annually and is prone to human error. Insurance carriers are at a high risk of failing state compliance tests and getting fined due to human errors.

### **🤖 Our Solution:**

We use a combination of LLMs and human judgment to read a customer’s documents and compile their information into the same final report created by premium auditors. We can do this within minutes, at half the cost, and with higher accuracy than any singular auditor.

### **📖 Our Story:**

We were originally S23 but decided to demo with W24 because we pivoted mid-batch from AI meeting notes (yeah, we know…). 

We talked to dozens of insurance workers and eventually learned about premium auditors. After talking to \~50 premium auditors, we had an inkling that their processes were ready for innovation. To better understand their jobs, we decided to go back to school in the middle of YC and take a community college class on premium auditing. 

Like any other college experience, we graduated from YC with 9-5 jobs as premium auditors. After working as premium auditors for 3 months, we were able to write code to automate parts of the premium audit process. AI and humans together led to unmatched performance and dramatically less cost, better than any auditor alone.

### **🙏 Our Ask:**

**Are you an insurance carrier or premium audit vendor:** We’d love to meet and see how we could fit into your workflow! Email us! 

**Customer Intros:** If you have contacts at insurance carriers or premium auditing vendors we'd love an introduction to talk to them! Email us!

\
Feel free to reach us at [founders@arcimus.com](mailto:founders@arcimus.com)

* Limited alerting, debugging
* Inadequate testing

With a command line tool, developers can easily create pipelines, auto document them, **run local tests**, and **run jobs with their favorite data warehouse.**

Serra is not tied to SQL and therefore handles all parts of ETL. Serra provides intuitive control flow, more complex transforms with Python, full streaming support, and comprehensive debugging/testing capabilities.

**TL;DR:** AI is changing how engineers work - it's time hiring caught up. Built by MIT engineers, NextByte tests for real-world skills, conceptual knowledge, and AI tool usage, not memorized algorithms.

## The Problem

Today's best engineers aren’t grinding Leetcode - they're vibe coding. AI copilots and codegen tools are making developers more productive than ever, yet tech hiring is stuck in the past.

Current coding screens reward those who memorize algorithms, not those who can actually build and problem solve. Worse, LLMs can ace many Leetcode problems better than humans, so what are these screens really testing?

## Our Solution

[NextByte](https://youtu.be/bVO5k4ssmGg)

NextByte is an AI-first interview platform that helps companies screen for the skills that actually matter. Our approach ensures that hiring decisions are based on practical ability rather than memorization.

#### Problem Creation

Instead of testing candidates on obscure theoretical concepts, we focus on challenges that reflect real engineering work. Our Magic Import tool helps companies design assessments tailored to their job descriptions, ensuring that candidates are evaluated on the skills they will actually use. We eliminate unnecessary algorithmic puzzles and instead measure problem-solving ability in a way that aligns with on-the-job performance.

#### Candidate Interview

Technical interviews should reflect how engineers actually work. Our process is interactive, guided, and built to evaluate both technical skill and thought process.

* **Conversational deep dives:** Our AI-driven voice discussions start with fundamental topics and push deeper based on candidate responses. This allows us to evaluate reasoning, adaptability, and true understanding – not just memorized answers.
* **Vibe Coding:** Our unique system design questions ask candidates to translate an image into text prompts and leverage cursor-like tools to generate code for their solution.
* **AI pair programmer:** Candidates receive real-time assistance, just like they would from a great colleague (or copilot). The AI helps navigate syntax, debugging, and edge cases, keeping the focus on problem-solving rather than getting stuck on minor details.

By mirroring a real-world coding environment, we prevent candidates from simply rehearsing answers and instead uncover how they think and work through challenges.

#### Results & Evaluation

A correct answer isn’t enough – we analyze the entire coding process to provide a deeper, more meaningful assessment of candidate ability including

* **Code quality:** Evaluate readability, documentation, and maintainability to ensure candidates write clean, production-ready code.
* **Efficiency:** Compare runtime and memory usage against other candidates, identifying optimization skills that go beyond just getting the correct output.
* **Conceptual understanding:** Assess depth of knowledge and ability to articulate complex ideas.

## The Team

We’re MIT grads, engineers, and longtime friends who have experienced the flaws of technical hiring firsthand.

Matt led post-training efforts for Enterprise LLMs at IBM Research delivering open weight models, including the Granite family which achieved state-of-the-art benchmarks that rivaled Meta's LLaMA 3. Jason worked on Home Relevance at Pinterest, leading the development of new recommendation systems that scaled non-pin content from zero to 100M daily impressions in months.

## Our Story

Despite working on different problems at different companies, we kept running into the same hiring issues.

As candidates, we saw how arbitrary and inconsistent technical interviews could be. As interviewers, we saw colleagues struggle to find time to properly evaluate applicants while juggling their own workloads. Some interviews were so broken that proctors would literally fall asleep on Zoom calls.

We built NextByte to fix this. Our goal is to make hiring decisions fairer, more efficient, and focused on what actually matters. We're helping companies identify the best engineers while giving candidates a better experience.

* Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/nextbyte-ai) for updates

Hiring should match the right people to the right roles. It rarely does. Five failures repeat on every search, and almost no one escapes them.

* **Privacy** — Looking around means risking your current job. There's no way to say "I'm open" without saying "I'm leaving”
* **Cost** — Recruiters take 20–30% of first-year salary, after weeks of back-and-forth, and the role still goes to someone they didn't find.

launches.body:
Hey YC, we’re Sahil, Maki, and Tony. We’re building Pluto ([talentpluto.com](https://talentpluto.com/))

Resumes made careers readable. LinkedIn made them searchable. Pluto makes them understood.

<https://youtu.be/gMuOogxpSo4>

**TL;DR** - A professional talks to Pluto for 10 minutes about what they’ve done, what they’re great at, and what they want next. Pluto makes that context discoverable to the right people and AI agents, helping them understand the person more fully. When there’s a real fit, Pluto can also make a warm introduction to a startup.

18K+ professionals have already shared their career context with Pluto. 100+ companies use Pluto to meet people with their full story, including Mercor, David AI, Rho, Warp, and Runlayer.

**Ask:** Talk to Pluto and let it get to know your work. If you’re hiring, send us the role and we’ll introduce you to people with context and confirmed interest.

### **The problem**

A resume and online profile are not enough for the AI era.

They show where someone worked and what title they had. They do not capture what the person actually did, what they are unusually good at, and what they want next.

That context usually lives in conversations. So professionals get reduced to keywords, logos, and titles, while the people and AI agents trying to understand them are left with an incomplete picture. 

Hiring makes this problem obvious. Companies miss great people because the real signal never makes it online. But as AI agents increasingly help people find, evaluate, and connect with one another, every professional will need a richer, more accurate way to be understood.

### **The solution**

Pluto is an AI voice agent that understands a professional’s career and puts that understanding to work.

Professionals talk to Pluto for 10 minutes about their experience, strengths, goals, preferences, and what they want to keep private. Pluto asks follow-up questions, remembers the context missing from their resume, and makes them discoverable to the right people and AI agents.

Companies tell Pluto who they want to meet. Pluto searches its network and the broader market, understands fit on both sides, privately confirms interest, and makes a warm introduction when both sides want to connect. No mass applications. Professionals stay private and in control. Companies meet people who are already understood.

**How It Works**

1. Talk to Pluto for 10 minutes
2. Review what it learned and choose what to share
3. Get found and understood by the right people and AI agents
4. Get introduced to startups when there’s a fit

### **Why We Started This**

The best hiring has always happened through trusted, high-context introductions. We think AI can make that possible for everyone.

Warm introductions are one way Pluto puts that understanding to work today. Long term, Pluto becomes the career context layer for the AI era - the version of a professional’s story that agents can understand, trust, and act on, while the professional stays in control.

### **Our Ask**

If you’re a professional, talk to Pluto and let it get to know your work. 

If you’re a founder, hiring leader, or talent engineer, send us the role you’re hiring for.

[talentpluto.com](http://talentpluto.com)

\- Sahil, Maki, Tony
